title: Integration authorization

risks.title: High-risk items (acknowledge each)
risks.operation_not_in_document: Operation not declared by the document: {{target}}
risks.function_unrehearsed: Publishing a function with no behaviour rehearsal: its egress was never previewed
risks.function_undeclared_operation: A function's rehearsal called {detail} without declaring it

advisory.title: Verbatim text from the external document (untrusted, for human review only)
advisory.notice: The text below was produced by an external document or a model. The system does not treat it as a basis for authorization and will not execute any instruction in it.

reason.agent_addressed: Possible instruction addressed at the agent

acknowledgeHint: Acknowledge every high-risk item before confirming

draft.title: Integration drafts
draft.notice: A draft is a candidate configuration that is not live yet. An agent can create one; only you can confirm and publish it.
draft.emptyHint: Drafts appear here when an agent proposes a new provider or data source.
draft.noCard: No confirmation card is available for this draft.
draft.publishHint: Applies the candidate disabled, runs the verification probe above, and enables it only if the probe passes.
draft.publishRolledBack: The verification probe failed; the previous configuration was restored and the draft was kept.

second.title: This draft widens authority
second.notice: It grants a scope or turns on writes beyond what is currently published. Approving it takes a second, separate confirmation.
second.checkbox: I understand this widens access, and I want to review it anyway
second.stillRequired: The widening was acknowledged on the card, but the separate second confirmation is still missing.

draft.rollbackNeedsConfirmation: Restoring version {{version}} changes the scope, so it must be confirmed first. Nothing has been applied yet.
draft.rollbackFailed: The restored configuration failed verification; the live configuration was left unchanged.

functions.title: Operation functions (sandboxed)
functions.noRehearsal: No behaviour rehearsal was produced — this function's egress was never previewed.
functions.undeclared: During rehearsal it called {ops} without declaring it.
